SRC-DC-PLAN-TARGETS.quote: default operation targets of the plan emitter: depth layers 4, horizon 0.55, occlusion 0.25, specular sharpness 15, contrast 0.4, shadow temperature 0.45, accent luminance 0.5

SRC-DC-PLAN-DERIVATION.quote: plan emitter derives operator targets from graph energies and relation magnitudes with fixed offsets and gains, and attaches fixed secondary parameters; the source records no rationale for them

SRC-DC-PLAN-VOID-TARGET.quote: 目标负空间比例：由当前 voidEnergy 推导，向时代先验区间靠拢

SRC-DC-PLAN-GRAPH-FALLBACKS.quote: plan emitter readings when the graph lacks a node or relation: void 0.3, subject 0.5, boundary 0.8, light 0.4, material 0.5, relation magnitude 0.5; the source records no rationale

SRC-DC-PLAN-CONFLICT-TOLERANCE.quote: 计算每个提议值的区间（±15% 容差，最小绝对容差 0.05）
